question: At normal temperature and atmospheric pressure, ______ has a density of 1.87 kg/m³ , which is 1.5 times heavier than air and exists as a liquid below the critical temperature of 31°C.
solution:
The correct answer is __**carbon dioxide**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **At normal temperature and atmospheric pressure, CO₂ has a density of 1.87 kg/m³, which is 1.5 times heavier than air.**
 
• This means that CO₂ will sink to the ground and collect in low-lying areas.
 
• CO₂ also exists as a liquid below the critical temperature of 31°C.
 
• This means that CO₂ can be liquefied by simply cooling it down to a temperature below 31°C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hydrogen:-**

 
 
• **It is the lightest and most abundant element in the universe. **
 
• It is a colorless, odorless, and tasteless gas that is highly flammable.
 
• Hydrogen is found in water, natural gas, and petroleum.
 
• It is used in a variety of applications, including fuel cells, rocket fuel, and the production of fertilizer and chemicals.
 
 
 
• **Lithium:-**
 
 
• **It is a soft, silvery-white alkali metal that is the lightest solid element. **
 
• It is highly reactive and is easily oxidized. Lithium is found in rocks and minerals, and it is extracted from brine deposits.
 
• It is used in a variety of applications, including batteries, ceramics, and medicines.
 
 
 
• **Nitrogen:-**
 
 
• **It is a colorless, odorless, and non-flammable gas that makes up about 78% of the Earth's atmosphere. **
 
• It is essential for life and is found in proteins, DNA, and RNA.
 
• Nitrogen is also used in a variety of applications, including fertilizers, explosives, and the production of ammonia and other chemicals.
